fact_check.claim: Eligibility: first-year and sophomore applicants with at least 12 credits; juniors, seniors and bachelor's holders cannot apply
Deadline March 15, 2027 for fall 2027, fall only; decisions May and June
Prerequisites: 3 units language, 1 chemistry, 1 precalculus (HS counts); college microeconomics and Knight-standard writing
No minimum GPA; admitted generally 3.3 or better; same figure for all admitted transfers
No interviews; factors are coursework, essay, recommendations; no hospitality work listed
fact_check.note: Hotel page reread recorded in brief.

fact_check.claim: Up to 60 transfer credits, AP/IB/GCE at most 15; exam-credit table (AP Micro 5 = HADM 1410; IB Econ 7 = HADM 1410 + 3 electives; AP English 5 / IB English HL 7 = FWS; AP Stats none)
Resume conflict: central page lists resume for Hotel, Nolan page lists it only for first-year applicants
$85 fee, waived automatically when a burden and applicant applies for aid
Essay 250 to 650 words; College Report, Academic Evaluation, Mid-Term Report, transcripts by April 15, 2027
fact_check.note: brief essay, evaluation, Mid-Term and April 15 rows.

fact_check.claim: CSS Profile and FAFSA by March 15, 2027; HEOP Transfer Certification form for Nolan
Transfers need two to four semesters done; first-semester students not eligible
Community colleges: no preference, about a quarter of transfers
Course credit: about 80% similar, C or better, not refused for community college or online
fact_check.note: Opened the page: C minimum, about 80% similar, equivalency may not be denied by institutional setting or online mode. Page's 'regionally accredited' also in brief line 179.

fact_check.claim: Transfer GPA not part of Cornell GPA; transcript shows only previous school name and total credits
fact_check.note: Opened the page; both statements present.

fact_check.claim: Exam credit request by last day of instruction of first Cornell semester; Dec 7, 2026 in fall 2026
Transfer Option: no fee, resume for SC Johnson, March 15 in 2026, next application winter 2027, decisions mid-April to early May
Internal route: Cornell GPA 3.0, ECON 1110, 12-credit term, first or second year, essay 650 words, Dec 1 2026 11:59 pm ET spring, May 1 fall, office hours Nov 18, transferees excluded
Fall 2021 profile: Nolan 48 fall and 21 spring, 69 of 762
864 of 7,381 transfer applicants admitted fall 2025 = 11.7%
Tuition $73,946 for 2026-27, no NY resident break at endowed colleges
Our total $96,318 (tuition + $1,024 fees + double + Unlimited)
Double room $6,872 per semester; sophomore entrants live on campus one year; juniors exempt
Families up to $125,000 get tuition covered; up to $75,000 full cost; need-based only
Worked example: 30 college credits plus 12 AP credits = 42, under caps of 60 and 15
fact_check.note: 30+12=42 < 60; 12 < 15. 60 college credits leaves no room under the 60 cap: correct.
